title: A 3D walkthrough of the new proof about pi
title_zh: π 无理性指数新证明的 3D 讲解动画
author: imjustnewatai
post_text:
I asked Claude Fable 5.5 to explain OpenAI's new 23-page proof about π.
It came back with a narrated 2-minute 3D animation that walks through the proof itself.
The claim: the irrationality exponent of π is EXACTLY 2. Since 1953 the best proven bound had only crawled from 42 down to about 7.
